scope: bounded web literature and public patent screening; not a systematic review, originality guarantee or legal opinion

sources.title: Phosphorus-Doped Single Atom Copper Catalyst as a Redox Mediator in the Cathodic Reduction of Quinazolinones
sources.publication_date: 2025-03-19 accepted manuscript; 2025-03-27 version of record; 2025-05-26 issue
sources.locator: Abstract; Data Availability Statement; Supporting Information; Publication History
sources.verified_finding: Cu-N-P@NC with CuN3P1 coordination is used for electroreductive coupling/ring opening of quinazolinones; adsorption/desorption regulation is already part of the published contribution.
sources.limitation: Full text redirected to abstract. Exact molecular structures, stoichiometry, coordinates and potential reference are unknown in this audit.
sources.authorship: Hai-Tao Tang is a corresponding author, together with Wen-Hao Li and Dingsheng Wang; a multi-institution collaboration.

sources.title: Publisher preview of anchor paper, figure captions 4 and 5
sources.locator: Figure 4 caption; Figure 5 caption; page states preview supplied by Wiley
sources.verified_finding: Caption gives graphite anode, modified cathode, DMF, TBAPF6, additive string TDEA and galvanostatic batch conditions; Figure 5 describes natural-alcohol scope.
sources.limitation: Publisher preview hosted by ResearchGate is not full SI. Chemical figures could not be retrieved; acronym expansion and exact co-reactant identity remain unverified.

sources.title: BEAST DB: Grand-Canonical Database of Electrocatalyst Properties
sources.verified_finding: Potential-dependent catalyst ranking is already explicit: energetic-span rank of Fe(110) changes 1 to 3 and Ru(111) 2 to 1 between 0 and -0.25 V versus SHE for the NRR example.
sources.limitation: This is a thermodynamic-descriptor example, not a kinetic or transport validation for Cu-mediated quinazolinone chemistry. SHE values must not be reused as nonaqueous operating potentials.
sources.visual_review: p.10 Table 1 rendered and inspected locally; not a full-document visual review

sources.title: Multiscale Modeling of Mass Transport Effects on Oxygen Evolution Reaction Kinetics
sources.verified_finding: Constant-potential DFT, microkinetics and Nernst-Planck-Poisson transport were coupled for IrO2/RuO2; concentration gradients changed apparent kinetic behavior.
sources.limitation: No complete computational reproduction performed. Aqueous OER is chemically different; its pH assumptions and parameters cannot be copied into DMF organic electrosynthesis.

sources.title: Scaling Organic Electrosynthesis: The Crucial Interplay between Mechanism and Mass Transport
sources.locator: Abstract; Introduction; Overview of Reactor Designs and Flow Properties; Figure 5
sources.verified_finding: Three organic electrosyntheses show reaction-dependent responses to mass transport; capillary-gap and rotating-cylinder reactors probe diffusion/convection and support single-pass process development.
sources.limitation: This is experimental transport precedent, not CuN3P1-specific data. No numerical transport coefficient is imported here.

sources.title: Interfacing single-atom catalysis with continuous-flow organic electrosynthesis
sources.verified_finding: The combination of single-atom catalysis, organic electrosynthesis, flow reactors and computational planning was already proposed and discussed.
sources.limitation: A review is conceptual prior art, not proof that every proposed integration was experimentally realized.

sources.title: Single-Atom Iron Catalyst as an Advanced Redox Mediator for Anodic Oxidation of Organic Electrosynthesis
sources.verified_finding: Fe-SA@NC mediates organic anodic oxidation including cyclopropyl-amide ring opening and reports flow and gram-scale examples.
sources.limitation: Anodic Fe chemistry cannot establish cathodic Cu mechanism; no direct kinetic parameter transfer.

sources.title: Multiscale insights of interfacial transport and kinetics in acidic CO2 electroreduction
sources.locator: p.598 abstract and publication history; PMID 41530044
sources.verified_finding: Ab initio kinetics plus interfacial transport reproduces a non-monotonic FE profile and investigates cation accumulation, steric constraints and potential-dependent steps.
sources.limitation: Aqueous acidic CO2RR on Ag does not calibrate DMF or the anchor organic reaction; only a method-neighbor.

sources.title: Predicting the Stability of Single-Atom Catalysts in Electrochemical Reactions
sources.locator: Introduction and proposed thermodynamic cycle; abstract
sources.verified_finding: Electrochemical stability screening of Cr/Mn/Fe/Co single atoms on carbon supports accounts for support binding and solution species; simple isolated-site stability is insufficient.
sources.limitation: Thermodynamic stability is not kinetic lifetime. Aqueous Pourbaix treatment cannot be copied unchanged to nonaqueous conditions.

sources.title: Technoeconomic analysis of fine chemical electrosynthesis: a case study using electrooxidation of 2-methylnaphthelene to vitamin K3
sources.locator: Abstract; electrode lifespan and cost discussion
sources.verified_finding: The TEA addresses fine-chemical electrosynthesis and treats electrode replacement and lifespan as economic variables; authors include Zhejiang Medicine.
sources.limitation: Different chemistry and product. No K3 costs, prices, lifetime or commercial advantage is transferred to the anchor product.

sources.title: Production of chemical products using electrochemical flow systems and mediators and associated methods
sources.locator: Abstract; description of mediator circulation and fluid-stream residence time
sources.verified_finding: Prior public disclosure couples electrochemical flow systems, redox mediators and controlled stream residence times.
sources.limitation: No claim chart, patent-family completeness, legal status assessment or freedom-to-operate opinion; not evidence of the same Cu reaction.

sources.title: Gated electrodes for electrolysis and electrosynthesis
sources.locator: Abstract; claims 18 and 23; description of dynamic gate voltage
sources.verified_finding: Static/time-varying interfacial electrochemical control has prior patent disclosure.
sources.limitation: Gate-electrode design is not the proposed pulsed Cu-SAC project. No assessment of enforceability or infringement.

sources.title: Metal Nanowire Felt as a Flow-Through Electrode for High-Throughput Electrosynthesis
sources.verified_finding: Flow-through Cu nanowire electrodes were investigated for transport/charge-transfer-limited organic cyclization.
sources.limitation: Not single-atom catalysis; deposited version was not peer reviewed at posting. Later journal version was not traced in this bounded audit.

sources.title: Reaction-Condition- and Ensemble-Aware Screening of Dual-Atom ORR Catalysts via Physics-Informed Machine Learning
sources.publication_date: unknown; web index reports 2026, exact public date not verified
sources.locator: Indexed sections Training the GNN; Catalyst Design
sources.verified_finding: Indexed text describes condition-aware hydroxylation and configurational ensembles changing screening ranks relative to bare-structure models.
sources.limitation: Search metadata alone does not establish exact publication date relative to the audit cutoff. Flagged for follow-up and excluded from strict time-cutoff novelty conclusions.

evidence_conflicts.interpretation: Could be source typographic/OCR error or prior transcription error; neither explanation has been demonstrated.
evidence_conflicts.consequence: Do not instantiate an additive molecule, balance protons, assign oxidation mechanism, or calculate an additive-specific solvation/adsorption energy from either string.
evidence_conflicts.resolution_requirement: Obtain lawful original SI and readable reaction scheme/materials entry; check abbreviation, structure, supplier or CAS, and retain both historical records.
